groups.activity: spawn a Lich with Kuva Twin Stubbas
groups.meta: spawn Kuva Larvlings, a fast Capture

rows.label: Kuva Twin Stubbas Larvling
rows.note: the downed Larvling shows its weapon before you Mercy it

rows.label: Progenitor Warframe
rows.note: the Warframe you Mercy with sets the bonus element

conditions: After the screen flashes yellow, kill 15 enemies within about 30 seconds to spawn the Larvling.
If it is not Kuva Twin Stubbas, ignore it and finish the mission: that weapon will not show again until every other Kuva weapon has been shown. Aborting does not remove it.
You cannot Mercy a Larvling while you have an active Lich, Sister or Coda.
bonuses: The whole squad gets 100 Kuva when a Larvling goes down, Mercied or not.

groups.activity: get Requiem mods: crack Requiem relics
groups.meta: collect Requiem Mods, 3 mods per Lich

rows.label: Requiem mods
rows.note: every Lich needs a sequence of 3; each mod has 3 charges
rows.alt: Palladino sells retired Requiem I-IV relics at 10 Riven Slivers each, 10 of each a week

rows.label: Oull
rows.alt: 25% on a Lich's first fully correct stab

conditions: Requiem Eterna Relics come from Kuva Siphons, Kuva Floods and Thralls; a Kuva Flood always drops one.
Each vanquish uses one charge from every mod equipped; a mod with none left is Defiled.
bonuses: Oull stands in for any Requiem. Two Oulls cannot share a sequence.

rows.label: Requiem Murmurs
rows.note: Mercy Thralls on your Lich's planets; they reveal the 3 mods, not the order

rows.label: Correct sequence
rows.note: test it on the Lich with the Parazon

conditions: A wrong stab ranks the Lich up and moves it to the next planet (Earth, Mars, Ceres, Sedna, Kuva Fortress), and gives the whole squad 10 Murmurs.
Only Thralls on your own Lich's nodes raise its rage.
The Lich takes a share of mission rewards on its planet until you finish it.
bonuses: The first time you land the full correct sequence, 25% to drop Oull.
A Requiem Ultimatum summons the Lich at once.

conditions: Pick Vanquish, not Convert: Convert gives no weapon.
The weapon ignores its Mastery requirement but needs a weapon slot.
The Confrontation node needs one Railjack Intrinsic at rank 5.
bonuses: A vanquish has a 25% chance to drop a Requiem Ultimatum.

disclosures.title: Valence Fusion toward 60%
disclosures.body: Fuse two copies of Kuva Twin Stubbas; stop at your first usable roll. Fusion multiplies the higher bonus by 1.1, rounded down, capped at 60%; 58% or more becomes 60%. Start from the copy you want to keep; the donor's Catalyst, Forma and Exilus adapter are lost. Fusion lets you pick which copy's element survives. Elemental Vice, from Eleanor of The Hex, swaps the element freely once the weapon is rank 40 (5 Forma).
